spans.s: līlāyitatva, nt. (cf. Skt. līlāyita), bodily transformation: Mvy 〔9428〕. So Tib. lus bsgyur ba, and second Chin. gloss; first one seems to mean swaying of the body, doubtless thinking of the primary mg. of Skt. līlā.
līlin, adj. (from Skt. līlā with -in), enjoying sport or pastime: ajarāmaralīlī Mmk 〔80.3〕; 〔83.20—21〕.
